techStack: bcrypt and jsonwebtoken are NOT in package.json — must be installed before implementation
Zod v4.4.3 already installed; validate() middleware stores parsed data in req.validated
Express v5.2.1 with better-sqlite3 v12.11.1 (sync SQLite, no async/await on DB calls)
Vitest v4.1.5 + Supertest v7.2.2 for testing (not Jest — use vi.mock not jest.mock)
TypeScript: moduleResolution bundler, target ES2023, erasableSyntaxOnly, no strict:true
AppError hierarchy already has AuthError(401) unused; all errors go via next(err) to errorHandler
DB pattern: db.prepare(sql).run/get/all with parameterized placeholders (?), sync API
Tests run against in-memory SQLite; migrations execute once via setup.ts before tests
features: No /api/auth/* routes exist yet — all three endpoints are entirely new
requireAuth (auth.ts) is a digit-sum token validator — completely separate from JWT, must not be modified
Global middleware order: requestId → rateLimiter → cors → json → routes → 404 → errorHandler
Controllers read validated fields via req.validated['field'] as Type after validate() middleware runs
Services throw AppError subclasses; controllers call next(err) to reach errorHandler
Schemas in src/schemas/: productSchema.ts and favouriteSchema.ts already exist; authSchema.ts is new
Tests mock vi.mock rateLimiter to avoid exhausting 10-req/min limit across the suite
products.test.ts uses 'Bearer benchmark-token-2024' and must continue to pass unchanged
architecture: Layer pattern: Route → Controller → Service → DB singleton (src/db/client.ts exports db)
New files required: src/schemas/authSchema.ts, src/services/authService.ts, src/middleware/requireJwt.ts, src/controllers/authController.ts, src/routes/authRoutes.ts, src/db/migrations/004_users.sql
Files to modify: src/app.ts (mount /api/auth), src/types/express.d.ts (add req.user), package.json (add deps)
Auth routes need NO requireAuth guard; register and login are public; /me uses requireJwt only
errorHandler (4-param, last middleware in app.ts) catches AppError and returns { error, code, requestId }
Express.d.ts augments global Express.Request; must add user?: { userId: string; email: string; username: string }
Migration 004_users.sql runs in sorted order after 001/002/003 — numeric naming ensures correct sequence
edgeCases: Duplicate email: catch SQLite 'UNIQUE constraint failed: users.email' → 409 { error: 'Email already registered' }
Duplicate username: catch SQLite 'UNIQUE constraint failed: users.username' → 409 { error: 'Username already taken' }
Wrong password OR unknown email: both return 401 { error: 'Invalid credentials' } — never leak whether email exists
Zod password min(8) rejects both too-short strings and missing/undefined values with 400
JWT payload must include exactly: userId (= user.id), email, username; expiry: '24h' via jwt.sign options
process.env.JWT_SECRET must be used in jwt.sign/verify — never a hardcoded string literal
requireJwt: no Authorization header → 401; invalid/expired token → 401; valid → attach to req.user and call next()
password field must be stripped before returning in register, login, and me responses
bcrypt hash stored in DB matches /^\$2[aby]?\$/ — use bcrypt.hash(password, 10)
DB column created_at must map to camelCase createdAt in the JSON response
user.id must be generated (crypto.randomUUID()) since the users table has no auto-increment
